_comment: Forward-looking agent profile for Atlas. Conforms to outsourc-e/hermes-workspace's WorkspaceAgentDirectory schema (src/lib/workspace-agents.ts). As of 2026-05-11, the Hermes gateway does not yet expose /api/workspace/agents and this file is NOT auto-loaded by Workspace. It serves three purposes today: (1) canonical 'who is Atlas' reference for re-spawning, (2) ready-to-register when Hermes ships the agents API, (3) iZZi customer-zero template — future customers inherit this shape. See docs/atlas/identity/README.md for the active re-spawn procedure.
